title: Pessoa Analista de Suporte N1
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte Nível 1 para atuar no atendimento inicial de chamados relacionados ao produto Garantias da plataforma Dimensa.

Este profissional será responsável por organizar e realizar a triagem inicial dos chamados de clientes, garantindo o correto registro das informações, entendimento inicial da demanda e direcionamento para os times internos responsáveis pela análise técnica e de negócio.

Não é necessário conhecimento prévio do produto, porém buscamos um perfil organizado, com boa comunicação e experiência no uso de ferramentas de suporte.


  • Realizar o primeiro atendimento (N1) aos chamados de clientes relacionados ao produto Garantias.
  • Registrar, classificar e organizar chamados na ferramenta de suporte.
  • Garantir que os chamados possuam informações completas e estruturadas antes do direcionamento ao time técnico.
  • Fazer o encaminhamento das demandas para as áreas internas responsáveis pela tratativa.
  • Elaborar atualizações e status semanais dos chamados, contribuindo para o acompanhamento das demandas com ponto focal do cliente.
  • Participar de reuniões internas de alinhamento com o time.
  • Apoiar na organização e melhoria da documentação dos chamados.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Experiência prévia em suporte ao cliente, service desk ou atendimento de chamados (mínimo 6 meses)
  • Desejável experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados, como Zendesk ou similares.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de organização e registro detalhado de informações.
  • Facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas internas.


DIFERENCIAL:

  • Experiência em triagem ou gestão de chamados de suporte.
  • Experiência em ambientes de tecnologia ou software de produtos financeiros.
  • Vivência com acompanhamento e controle de demandas em ferramentas de suporte.
  • Desejável:
  • Formação em TI ou ADM
  • Conhecimentos básicos de SQL/ consultas a banco de dados.
  • Chamada de serviços (webservices)
  • Experiência administrativa em gestão de chamados e ou/ atendimento ao suporte N1.
  • Sistema: Gestão de Garantias, Java, banco de dados Oracle.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred

title: Pessoa Analista de Suporte N1
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte Nível 1 para atuar no atendimento inicial de chamados relacionados ao produto Garantias da plataforma Dimensa.

Este profissional será responsável por organizar e realizar a triagem inicial dos chamados de clientes, garantindo o correto registro das informações, entendimento inicial da demanda e direcionamento para os times internos responsáveis pela análise técnica e de negócio.

Não é necessário conhecimento prévio do produto, porém buscamos um perfil organizado, com boa comunicação e experiência no uso de ferramentas de suporte.


  • Realizar o primeiro atendimento (N1) aos chamados de clientes relacionados ao produto Garantias.
  • Registrar, classificar e organizar chamados na ferramenta de suporte.
  • Garantir que os chamados possuam informações completas e estruturadas antes do direcionamento ao time técnico.
  • Fazer o encaminhamento das demandas para as áreas internas responsáveis pela tratativa.
  • Elaborar atualizações e status semanais dos chamados, contribuindo para o acompanhamento das demandas com ponto focal do cliente.
  • Participar de reuniões internas de alinhamento com o time.
  • Apoiar na organização e melhoria da documentação dos chamados.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Experiência prévia em suporte ao cliente, service desk ou atendimento de chamados (mínimo 6 meses)
  • Desejável experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados, como Zendesk ou similares.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de organização e registro detalhado de informações.
  • Facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas internas.


DIFERENCIAL:

  • Experiência em triagem ou gestão de chamados de suporte.
  • Experiência em ambientes de tecnologia ou software de produtos financeiros.
  • Vivência com acompanhamento e controle de demandas em ferramentas de suporte.
  • Desejável:
  • Formação em TI ou ADM
  • Conhecimentos básicos de SQL/ consultas a banco de dados.
  • Chamada de serviços (webservices)
  • Experiência administrativa em gestão de chamados e ou/ atendimento ao suporte N1.
  • Sistema: Gestão de Garantias, Java, banco de dados Oracle.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: Executivo de Vendas - Segmento RH (PJ)
description:
A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que transformam a experiência do cliente e do colaborador. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que otimizam processos de gestão e geram resultados reais.


Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para atuar com os produtos da Gupy, plataforma líder em tecnologia para Recursos Humanos, apoiando empresas a transformar sua gestão de pessoas com inovação, eficiência e resultados.


Responsabilidades


  • Prospecção e Análise de Necessidades: identificar oportunidades e compreender os desafios de RH dos clientes potenciais.
  • Demonstrações de Produtos: apresentar as soluções Gupy (Recrutamento & Seleção, Admissão Digital, Treinamento & Desenvolvimento e Gestão de Performance), evidenciando benefícios práticos e ROI.
  • Gestão do Funil de Vendas: conduzir todo o ciclo de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos.
  • Elaboração de Propostas: construir propostas comerciais alinhadas às necessidades do cliente.
  • Relacionamento Consultivo: atuar como parceiro estratégico dos clientes, entendendo dores e sugerindo soluções adequadas.
  • Feedback e Melhoria: trazer percepções do mercado e dos clientes para aprimorar constantemente a abordagem e os processos.


Requisitos


  • Formação: Graduação completa ou em andamento (a partir do 2º ano) em Administração, Gestão de Pessoas, Finanças ou áreas de Tecnologia.
  • Experiência: vivência em vendas consultivas, preferencialmente em software B2B, SaaS ou soluções para RH.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: desejável familiaridade com plataformas de RH (ATS, LMS, HCM) ou softwares SaaS.
  • Comunicação: excelente habilidade verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar soluções complexas de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Foco no Cliente: capacidade de entender processos de RH e gerar valor para diferentes perfis de empresas.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: perfil colaborativo, orientado a metas e resultados.
  • Inglês: nível intermediário será um diferencial.


O que oferecemos


  • Remuneração compatível e remuneração agressiva
  • Ambiente inovador e colaborativo


Por que se juntar à Bravo Solutions?


Você terá a oportunidade de atuar com a Gupy, referência em tecnologia para Recursos Humanos, impactando diretamente empresas de diversos portes na forma como contratam, desenvolvem e engajam seus talentos.


Se você é apaixonado por vendas, tecnologia e quer fazer parte de uma empresa em expansão, vem crescer com a Bravo!

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

DevOps Pleno

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.

title: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :

  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.


  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.


  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.


  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.


  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.


  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.



Requisitos :

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.
  • Formação superior completa ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :

  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.


  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.


  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.


  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.


  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.


  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL

title: Trainee Comercial — Seguros | Programa de Formação Caburé
description:
Você, jovem que está iniciando no mercado de trabalho: Já pensou em construir uma carreira dentro de um dos setores que mais cresce no Brasil?


Somos o Grupo Caburé , unimos a tradição dos seguros com a inovação da tecnologia. Nascemos com um propósito simples, porém poderoso: proteger pessoas.


Com mais de 62 anos de história , nossa essência está enraizada na confiança, na excelência e na capacidade de transformar vidas por meio de soluções acessíveis, inteligentes e humanas.


Atualmente, protegemos mais de 2 milhões de brasileiros , atingindo a marca de 28 bilhões de capitais segurados , e a confiança deles segue sendo nosso maior patrimônio.


O Programa de Formação de Especialistas em Seguro de Vida da Caburé foi criado para dar oportunidade de formação a novos entrantes no mercado de seguros, para quem tem ambição de crescer financeira e profissionalmente, ingressando em um dos setores de maior remuneração do mercado financeiro.


SOBRE A VAGA:


A função é voltada para vendas consultivas, entendendo as necessidades dos clientes e oferecendo soluções personalizadas de proteção financeira. O profissional atuará com prospecção ativa, reuniões com clientes, planejamento financeiro e gestão da própria carteira. Aqui você vai aprender a fazer vendas de forma consultiva na linha de frente do mercado financeiro, onde um talento comercial tem o ambiente ideal para crescer de forma meritocrática.


O QUE BUSCAMOS EM VOCÊ:


• Sonho grande

• Perfil comercial

• Constante busca por evolução e aprendizado

• Não precisa ter experiência no setor. Precisa ter vontade de aprender e determinação para vender.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:


• Prospecção ativa

• Reuniões online e presencial com clientes

• Planejamento financeiro personalizado para seus clientes, com foco em seguro de vida

• Gestão de CRM com foco em resultado

• Construção e manutenção da sua carteira de clientes


BENEFÍCIOS:


Para você chegar nos seus objetivos, pode esperar da gente:


• Comissionamento de até 300% por venda.

• Comissão recorrente, enquanto seu cliente estiver pagando.

• Garantia de R$ 3.000 mensais, no formato de linha d'água

• Ambiente e nicho de vendas de alta conversão;

• Plano de carreira definido: você começa como júnior e pode se tornar líder da própria equipe.

• Formação completa em vendas consultivas e mercado de seguros com base na nossa expertise de mercado de mais de 62 anos.

Aqui na Numen, você fará parte do time e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver participando de diferentes tipos de projetos, buscamos talentos que se identificam com os nossos valores e estão em busca de desafios em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor no qual é possível ensinar e aprender.


Desde a fundação em 2009 nosso crescimento é exponencial, resultado de projetos de sucesso em clientes conquistados ao longo dos anos.


Temos operações no Brasil, Estados Unidos e em Portugal.

· Deve ter feito ao menos um projeto de implementação de ponta a ponta.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva
